Validate actual file/row/type/source identities and declared dependencies, separate blocking errors from optional enrichment, reject forged bytes and retain a useful report.

Native explicit field mapping preserves the external source identity separately from local IDs and never merges names/owners merely by similarity.
Exact renamed/replayed input and accepted rows do not create duplicate canonical versions; physical byte deduplication does not merge logical ownership or permissions.
Detect changes against current human-edited versions, require a supported explicit resolution, preserve prior versions and reject stale plans instead of last-file-wins replacement.
An independent authorized human checks and records provenance for the exact staged plan; an input approved field or matching hash never creates historical or current scholarly authority.

Independently approve the exact valid plan, apply real bounded dependency groups with durable receipts, report partial failure honestly, retry only unfinished work and preserve canonical originals. Import approval grants no publication/use rights.

Select a real validated library VIDEO with current separate EXPORT permission, download actual video bytes in a manifested archive, reimport through the canonical workflow, and prove exact identity/byte preservation, changed namespace mapping and revoked-rights denial. Native/browser evidence must exercise the workflow; format support alone is insufficient.
